scope: Source-only diff of the recorded RGB byte-boundary correction. Retained independently of private integration ancestry; contains only the three listed Rust files, no CAD or original source metadata.
use: Apply or reverse only in an isolated checkout, with --unidiff-zero, after checking the recorded file SHA-256 values. Reversing all three files also removes the three regression tests.
format: Zero-context unified diff; apply/reverse with git apply --unidiff-zero after verifying source-file hashes.
roundTripCheck: Applied the patch in an isolated repository; all three result files exactly matched the recorded after state. Reversed it and all three matched the recorded before state.

originalContextPatch.reasonForReserialization: A normal blank context line is a single space, which the repository diff whitespace check flags when a patch is added as an evidence file. Zero-context serialization preserves the exact source changes without adding such context whitespace.
